fixtures.goal: select Misty Rainforest only when an actual green fetch line is potentially enabled
do not prioritize Evolving Wilds as if it gave an immediate untapped green source

evidence_guards: Replay exactly first 41 original accepted actions with exact original event and life equivalence before invoking baseline or opt-in AI.
Do not change any production/current/R5 profile; candidate is an ephemeral local copy with one existing boolean flag only.
Record both baseline and candidate actual legal one-step actions, not prospective wins.
Positive effect only if A chooses Misty while CONTROL avoids Evolving; a changed tie or candidate action without funded follow-up is not a promoted policy.
Original games used no mulligans; this study changes only one turn-one decision score. All opponent responses beyond action 41 are unobserved in the counterfactual.
